[B][COLOR accent_color]FenSkeleton — Setup Guide[/COLOR][/B]
Fen-Mage is the skin built for FenSkeleton. Big thanks to Ivar Brandt for FenMage (Estuary MOD) — the foundation this skin is built on.
[B][COLOR accent_color]First Install — Empty Home Screen[/COLOR][/B]
On first install the home screen will be empty. The Movie and TV Show sections will be missing from the main menu. Follow the steps below to get everything set up.
[B][COLOR accent_color]Step 1 — Show the Movie / TV Show Sections[/COLOR][/B]
From the home screen go to: [B]Settings » Interface » Skin section » Configure skin... » Main menu items[/B]
Click a menu item to toggle it on or off. Toggle [B]Movies[/B] and [B]TV Shows[/B] to ON.
[B]NOTE:[/B] Even with these toggled on, they won't appear on the home screen until you set a main menu path for them (see Step 2).
[B][COLOR accent_color]Step 2 — Set the Main Menu Path[/COLOR][/B]
After toggling a section on, a couple of sub-items will drop down.
Click [B]"Set main menu path"[/B] and choose a path from within FenSkeleton — for example your Trakt Movie or TV Show collection.
[B][COLOR accent_color]Step 3 — Set Up Widgets[/COLOR][/B]
Click [B]"Set widgets"[/B] to configure up to:
• 10 Movie widgets • 10 TV Show widgets
For each widget you can set:
• The source path • A label • Display type: [B]Poster[/B], [B]Landscape[/B], [B]LandscapeInfo[/B], or [B]Category[/B]
If you choose [B]Category[/B] you can also set it up as a stacked widget and choose its display type.
[B][COLOR accent_color]Step 4 — Editing Widgets After Setup[/COLOR][/B]
Click any existing widget to get a list of options:
• Rearrange • Rename • Remake (change path or display type) • Remove
You can also rename, remake, or remove main menu items themselves.
[B][COLOR accent_color]Reporting Issues[/COLOR][/B]
• Read the [B]Changelog[/B] first (Extra info tab in Skin settings). • Pre-made builds are [B]not supported[/B]. • Trakt issues are not skin related — contact the relevant addon developer. • Error reports [B]must[/B] include a log file or they will be closed. • Check existing open issues before opening a new one. • Do [B]not[/B] hijack an open issue with an unrelated problem.
